composition_record.method: Explicit original subjects, invertible recurring countersubject, constrained independent counterpoint, polychoral expositions and constructive all-part ensemble.
limitations: Structural sonorities are conservative triads; later dense episodes deliberately prolong common tones.
Inner voice crossings are allowed; the principal upper and lower lines remain stable.
The short stretto overlaps a terminal tonic with the subject head; it is not a close four-way stretto.
Automated interval checks do not establish stylistic or aesthetic equivalence to Bach.

dense_revision.method: Continuing older choirs, subject-contour inner counterpoint, an added directed tutti paragraph and the closing ensemble.

second_edition_rhythmic_revision.method: Recurring thematic variants admitted across all their statements; stepwise free-line connections; prepared suspensions. Independent event and structural-grid screens retain the baseline constraints. No random notes or concealed staggered parallels.

performance_revision.description: Deterministic subject/countersubject balance, phrase arches, metrical articulation, connected suspensions, cadence release and keyboard-register stereo placement.
performance_revision.timing: No onset displacement, random timing, tempo changes, or written-duration changes.
